# Application index

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/docs/build_docs.ts - do not edit by hand; run `bun run docs:build` -->

Every tool that the launcher detects in this repository (`bun run cli:launcher --list`). **170 tools**: 65 studios (windowed apps), 78 command-line tools and 27 demos.

The launcher does **not** list itself (`applications/launcher_studio.ts`, [guide](../getting-started/install-and-first-launch.md#step-5-open-the-launcher)) and hides helper files whose names contain `_server.`, `_crud.`, `_engine.` or `_ops.`; so the visual designer (`index.ts`) and the launcher are not in this table either.

The *Automated start check* column (studios only) is what `tests/applications_smoke.test.ts` verifies on every test run: either the studio starts headless with `--server` and answers `GET /` with an HTML page, or its module loads in a fresh process without error. **It never checks the native window or any feature inside the studio.** The *Launch command* column is the command the launcher itself uses; *Short name* is a `package.json` script, when one exists. A launch command being listed does **not** mean the tool was run for this handbook: see the [coverage matrix](../documentation-maintenance/coverage-matrix.md) for what was verified. Descriptions come from the launcher's built-in list or the file's own header comment; "(none in source)" means the code has no description.
